name: TheTVDB API
tagline: TV series, episode, and artwork metadata API for media libraries and scrapers
description: TheTVDB provides a v4 REST API for TV series, seasons, episodes, movies, people, artwork, and related metadata. Developers create a project API key through their account dashboard, exchange it at POST /login for a one-month Bearer JWT, and send that token on later requests. Access is available through revenue-based project licensing or a separate subscriber-supported API-key/PIN model.

auth.details: Project API key via POST /login for a Bearer JWT; send Authorization: Bearer <token> on subsequent requests. Self-serve keys in Subscriber Portal.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free project licensing applies when annual company revenue is under $50,000 and requires attribution. The public pricing page lists no numeric request allowance.
pricing.paid_plans: Subscriber tiers (user/commercial) via TheTVDB Subscriber Portal; exact plan names/prices not confirmed from public docs alone

use_cases: look up a TV series by name or TVDB id
list seasons and episodes for a series
fetch episode air dates and absolute numbers
get series artwork and posters for a media library
resolve people (actors/creators) linked to a show
search multilingual TV metadata for scrapers
